integrity: The classification is derived from the published conic equations by exact projective coefficient comparison and exact rational-function identities. The package includes an exact replay script using only Python's standard library.
limitations: The claim classifies projective equivalence only inside the displayed one-parameter family over the complex numbers.
It does not classify arbitrary triples of conics with the same contact data.
No claim about automorphisms of the associated degree-eight curves is made beyond the auxiliary triple-conic geometry.
title: Projective moduli and isotropy of Hemmig's triple-conic family
